requirement.value: Cartomancer (Ace of Cards), Fury, Rogue, Sharpshooter or Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) mastery

system.description: When you resolve Magic Pair, if the free attack uses an arcane, dagger, firearm, sword or thrown weapon, you deal extra damage equal to the pair's common value and recover twice that value in MP. The MP return is the point: Magic Cards costs at least 10 MP a use, so a Duel Master resolving pairs runs close to cost-neutral on the engine. It stacks with Double or Nothing, which touches the attack's High Roll and never the pair's value.
